core_problem_solved: To provide a high-performance, full-featured, and cross-platform text search engine library, enabling applications to perform powerful indexing and searching capabilities without needing a separate server.
key_features: High-performance indexing and searching of text data
Ranked searching, returning the most relevant results first
Numerous query types (phrase, wildcard, fuzzy, boolean, etc.)
era_and_niche: The foundational and industry-standard open-source search library, written in Java. It is the underlying engine for virtually all major open-source search platforms, most notably **Apache Solr** and **Elasticsearch**.
reason_for_obsolescence: This library is **not obsolete**; it is a state-of-the-art core technology. However, most developers **do not use Lucene directly**. The common and recommended approach is to use a full-featured search server like **Elasticsearch** or **Solr**, which use Lucene internally and expose its functionality via a much higher-level, distributed REST API.
